chunks: And with this chain of narrators, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
O God! Bless my nation in its mornings on its Saturday and Thursday.

key_terms.صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Saturday and Thursday mornings in Islamic supplications?
ai.summary: This supplication, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, emphasizes the unique spiritual vitality of Thursday and Saturday mornings, a tradition deeply rooted in Shia practice where these days are associated with increased divine mercy and the gathering of the faithful. It reflects the broader Islamic emphasis on specific times for worship, linking the Prophet's prayer for his Ummah to the tangible blessings experienced during these weekly cycles.
